## Use case

What are you trying to do? Describe the problem or scenario, not the
solution.

## Proposed sketch

A rough idea of what the feature might look like — config shape, API
surface, behavior. Don't worry about being precise; the point is to
illustrate the shape.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why they didn't fit.

## Additional context

Links to upstream provider docs, related issues, prior art in similar
projects.
